info.name: WildApricot Admin Accounts Finances.Payments API
info.description:
The WildApricot Admin API provides programmatic access to membership management features including contacts, events, event registrations, membership levels, invoices, payments, donations, email campaigns, and store orders. Authentication uses OAuth2 with client credentials or authorization code flow.

Contact Support:
 Name: WildApricot Support

item.name: WildApricot Get List of Payments by Criteria.

query.description: Identifier of contact who made the payment.
Identifier of event. When specified API returns collection of payments settled to invoices associated with event registrations for the event.
When set to true, API returns only collection of identifiers instead of collection of payments.
Limits result to payments created since StartDate.
Limits result to payments created before EndDate.
Limits result to payment type.
When set to true, API returns only unsettled payments.
You can filter the payments by specifying a set of payment IDs.

response.name: Collection of payments that match criteria.
